title: hypericum nummulariifolium
intro: Hypericum nummulariifolium, commonly known as Small-leaved St. John's Wort, is a species of flowering plant in the St. John's Wort family. It is used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to alleviate anxiety and depression due to its health benefits such as acting as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Hypericum nummulariifolium include its anxiolytic, anti-inflammatory, and spasmolytic effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include naphthodianthrones, phytosterols, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
